decisions.reason: The operator training programme required little investment and is peripheral to the announced future direction, so despite an earlier own page, management sees little justification to persist and drops it.
The fourth rotary axis accessory involved modest investment and was only mentioned on the website, so with little sunk cost and no strong public commitment, management drops it.
Hybrid additive post-processing is central to the announced materials-processing direction and likely required substantial investment, so management persists and keeps it.
High-speed CNC milling is close to the established offer, was given a dedicated web page, and is central to production solutions, so high sunk costs and public commitment make dropping unlikely.
Automatic tool change builds on the established offer, has a visible own page, and is central to efficient production, so management keeps it due to investment and commitment.
